title: One pathogen or viroid test of one sample (HLVd, a virus, a bacterium), as a laboratory reports it. Slot 0 is the call: 1 detected, 0 not detected. Slot 1 is the cycle threshold (Ct) when the method gives one, times 100. Which target, which method and which sample are in the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2), not here. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
